O-GlcNAcPRED-DL

Deep-learning O-GlcNAc site prediction

Submit human or mouse protein sequences in FASTA format. Use pasted input for a single sequence, or upload a FASTA file for multiple proteins.

Private by design: prediction runs in your browser, and your protein sequence is not uploaded.
